hero.subtitle: Tokens refill through the day. Each one gets you a capsule with a card inside, from common to legendary. Collect them, level them up, and put them to work in turn-based fights.

experience.description: There are two 3D machines, a capsule dispenser and a claw machine. If you just want to see the card, there's also a mode with no animation at all.

rarity.description: From rare upwards, a card can drop holographic or brilliant instead of standard. Duplicates aren't wasted: they turn into dust, which buys the cards you're missing in the daily shop.

standard.name: Standard
standard.description: The regular version. Most of your cards will look like this.

holographic.name: Holographic
holographic.description: A rainbow foil over the art. The rarest of the three, only on rare, epic and legendary cards.

brilliant.name: Brilliant
brilliant.description: An animated shine and its own reveal.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Start a team with your friends. Every week you go after the same raid boss together, and you can challenge each other to duels and bet on the outcome.

campaign.title: Campaign
campaign.description: Nine chapters of turn-based fights with a team of up to three cards. Stats, passives, gear and elements all count.

points.cards: Cards level up and wear gear
points.skills: Your account has its own skill tree

tower.title: Tower
tower.description: One tower per element, and each floor is harder than the last. This is where you find out how far your team can really go.

explainer.title: A card game based on Japanese capsule machines.

intro.rest: is a card collecting game based on gashapon, the capsule vending machines you find all over Japan: you get tokens every day, spend one on a capsule, and open it to find a card: common, uncommon, rare, epic or legendary.

dust.middle: , which you spend in the daily shop on specific cards, or on your skill tree. A
dust.after: counter makes sure bad luck runs out: go too long without a rare card and the next one is guaranteed.

variants.after: . Only rare cards and above can drop holographic or brilliant, and even then it doesn't happen often.

explainer.outro: Your cards are also your fighters: campaign, tower, team raid and duels. If you want to track your pulls outside the site, there's a public API and a Discord bot.

finalCta.title: Give it a try.
finalCta.line1: Sign up, grab your tokens, pull a capsule.

footer.tagline: A card collecting game based on Japanese capsule machines.
